_doc: Difficulty levers (GDD 4.23, D7) [balance]. Chosen when the game is created and saved in WorldState.difficulty. Each lever enters with its system; H3: start_debt (GDD 4.16, the loan of the start), rival_craft and rival_sell_min_demand (the rival smith, GDD 4.5.5: they replace the profile's figures), buy_price_mult (market purchase price). The targets of data/targets.json are those of normal. H12 Patrón: harvest_mult (the yield of a harvest, Fields.harvest_of: good land or poor). H7: microevent_chance (GDD 4.20, 4.23: x0.7 / x1 / x1.3 the daily chance of a microevent). H13: ai (04c 4.21.10), read only by the hostility of the rival families (sim/ai/hostility.gd, the maps of data/ai.json hostility_maps): threshold_offset (added to the profile's rivalry_threshold), attack_cooldown_days (one attacker), player_attack_gap_days (between attacks on the player, of anyone), hostile_weight, noise (the sigma of the choice). The Rogue (H12): rogue.check_mod (added to the thief's rolls: purse, storage, flight) and rogue.fence_mult (what the fence pays).
